purpose: Learning line for coordinates: treasure map and coordinate system (years 4-m1).
details: Map size grows; the coordinate system with axes appears in m1. Loaded by kern/leerlijnen.py (laad/parameters) which the topic's generator calls with the child's school year; checked by tests/test_leerlijnen.py and turned into the handbook tables by docs/tools/handleiding.py.

field_notes.explanation: The stored skill id this learning line belongs to; the same as the file name. Stored ids are never renamed.
A short Dutch description of the skill (shown in the handbook and reports).
Goals of the skill (a list; empty for most skills).
The parameters of this skill and their type name (lijst, int, bool, tekst, getal); a value of the leerlijn must match.
Per school year (3, 4, 5, 6, m1, m2) the parameter values; a missing or null year means the skill is not offered then (the level cannot be chosen).
aflezen/aanduiden on the treasure map and, later, the same on the coordinate system (assen_*).
Number of columns of the grid or map.
Number of rows of the grid or map.
Largest absolute coordinate of the coordinate system (0 = the treasure map without axes).
